title_en: In Yzberisht, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout!!
description_en: In Yzberisht, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout!!! The apartment is located on the 8th residential floor of an 8-story building and has an area of ​​64.5 m2 gross, of which 54.5 m2 is net. It is organized by distribution corridor, living room together with kitchen area, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and 1 balcony. The property has regular mortgage documentation. The area where the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and quiet life.
